enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Doublestrike 16%: Passive: 16% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Armor-Piercing 22%: Passive: +22% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
